description: This file defines a class 'ClientAddressableTestConsumerGrain' implementing the 'IClientAddressableTestConsumer' interface. The class interacts with a producer via a rendezvous grain, with methods to set up the producer reference and poll it asynchronously.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTestConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain class that consumes or interacts with a producer grain in Orleans framework.

methods.description: Asynchronously polls the producer for data or status.
